title: NOMOS Chain Key Revocation Statement
description: A detached statement, signed by a key's own PARENT, withdrawing that key's standing to sign at all (NOMOS-SPEC-007 §5). Distinct from NOMOS-SPEC-006's revocation-statement.schema.json, which withdraws an ARTIFACT's validity, signed by the same key that sealed it — this withdraws a KEY's standing, signed by whoever certified it.

revoked_kid.description: The kid of the key being revoked.

reason.description: Free-text, human-readable. No closed enum mandated, matching NOMOS-SPEC-006 §3.2's reason field.

kid.description: Key id of the PARENT key that certified revoked_kid — the only key permitted to revoke it (NOMOS-SPEC-007 §5.1). A verifier MUST reject a statement whose kid does not resolve to the actual parent that certified revoked_kid.

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over JCS({ revoked_kid, reason, issued_at }).

issued_at.description: When the statement was signed. Part of the signed payload, same treatment as NOMOS-SPEC-006 §3's issued_at.
